description.en: Sets the team formation to use for a match side, by team slot and formation ID string (or numeric ID).
Index of the team/side to set the formation for.
Formation ID string (e.g. "ifb0301", hashed via CRC32) or numeric ID.
True once the formation ID has been stored for that team slot; null if fewer than 2 arguments were given or the call was otherwise invalid.

example.code:
// Set team 0's formation before the match starts
CMND_BTL_SET_FORMATIONID(0, "ifb0301");
